name: The Ocean Club, Costa Norte
positioning: Beach resort beside a private beach on Costa Norte in Sosua, Dominican Republic, officially The Ocean Club, a Luxury Collection Resort, Costa Norte
best_for: Travelers who want a private-beach resort with three pools and an ESPA spa
Families or groups wanting multi-bedroom suites

facts.text: The resort sits beside a sweeping private beach on Costa Norte in Sosua, Dominican Republic.
Every detail of the resort is inspired by the beauty and allure of the ocean.
The resort is near Sosua Beach and Playa Alicia.
Floor-to-ceiling windows open up the ocean-view rooms.
From the private terrace or balcony, guests look out on garden or ocean views.
One of the pools is a sea salt pool.
The spa is inspired by the south of France and offers fully personalized therapeutic treatments.
The fitness center has cardio and fitness equipment by Technogym.
La Cave Wine and Cigar Cellar pairs fine wines, Dominican rum and premium cigars, with expert-led tastings and mixology workshops.

highlights.text: The spa is the Ocean Club Spa by ESPA, offering wellness treatments that balance nature and tradition.
The resort has three pools, including an infinity pool.
The resort offers four-bedroom penthouse suites with a rooftop terrace.
Aguaji is inspired by the heritage of the Indigenous and Taino cultures of the Dominican Republic.

considerations.text: Tap water is not drinkable; guests should use bottled water.
The closest airport is Puerto Plata (POP), about 8.2 km from the hotel.
WhataHotel notes premium luxury pricing reflecting the high-end positioning.
